**Nvidia had the higher gross margin in fiscal 2025, by about 28.1 percentage points.**

Under the convention that a fiscal year is named for the calendar year in which it ends, Nvidia's fiscal 2025 is the year ended January 26, 2025.

- **Nvidia:** gross profit of $97,858M on revenue of $130,497M gives a gross margin of about 74.99%.
- **Apple:** gross margin of $195,201M on net sales of $416,161M gives about 46.90%.

The difference is 74.99% − 46.90% ≈ 28.08 percentage points.
